profile.headline: Incoming Software Engineer at Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: As a Computer Science major at Columbia University, I've applied my knowledge in practical settings, most notably as a Full Stack Developer Intern at BEN - Brand Engagement Network, Inc. There, my core competencies in Rust and WebAssembly contributed to enhancing the security and performance of BEN’s AI Assistant.

positions.title: Incoming Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Firebase Data Connect Team
• Designed the API for Data Connect’s Python Admin SDK, securing formal approval through collaborative review. 
• Engineered the DataConnect client and execute_graphql function using Python generics to enable AI/ML and data workflows.
• Investigated Node.js/TypeScript and Python’s underlying type and validation behavior to implement equivalent SDK functionality across languages

positions.title: Full Stack Developer (Intern)
positions.description:
• Created Rust/WebAssembly/C# SDK Library for BEN’s AI Avatar, refining security and reducing memory usage by 54%, tested in Docker
• Built JS messaging service linking front desk & WhatsApp via webhooks, integrating BEN’s AI and MongoDB to streamline request routing
• Built a Python crawler testing pipeline using Claude to generate simulated user inputs and test BEN’s AI conversation flows for consistency
• Migrated serving stack from PyTriton to Triton, improving LLM model throughput and reducing text generation latency by 0.7s
positions.insights: Skills: Rust (Programming Language) · WebAssembly · Celery · REST APIs · JavaScript · Python (Programming Language) · MongoDB · API Development · Postmtan

positions.title: Business Consulting Intern
positions.description:
• Conducted competitive benchmarking on material management systems at TSMC and Siemens to inform SK Hynix’s digital product roadmap
• Analyzed digital thread technologies and their integration to track and optimize material flows across the value chain
• Synthesized findings from TSMC expert interviews into actionable design requirements for a cross-functional system implementation

positions.title: Gen AI Intern
positions.description:
• Applied structured methodologies to optimize Generative AI performance, improving output accuracy by 56% under edge-case conditions
• Designed complex prompts that exposed model weakness, pushing AI boundaries through targeted stress testing and edge-case analysis
• Analyzed model outputs, identifying root causes of incorrect responses and rewriting completions to align with spec-compliant solutions

positions.title: Software Engineer | UX Designer
positions.description:
• Developed an MVP version of an app using Flutter and Firebase to display artifact information and enhance museum experiences
• Facilitated app deployment using CI/CD pipelines, reducing build times by 15%
• Integrated login with three user roles with apt authentication and authorization

company.name: Museum of Japanese Colonial History in Korea

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
(Previously DMLab)
• Developed a JavaScript webapp to host concurrent testing of 9+ AI models, optimizing LLM switching process by 24 hours
• Tailored the web app’s UI using HTML and CSS to showcase the company’s avatar technology for clients like Provana and Medadvisor 
• Constructed a PostgreSQL database to store and analyze user chatting sessions, improving data accessibility
positions.insights: Skills: CSS · Database Development · JavaScript · App Development · Node.js · HTML

positions.title: App Development Team Member
positions.description:
• Developed a pedestrian environmental algorithm to reduce pedestrian-related accidents for the visually impaired by a factor of 3.5.
• Optimized the path-finding algorithm (A* algorithm) employed within the company’s GPS-related applications by 7 seconds to find the most wheelchair-accessible, comfortable path between two locations.
positions.insights: Skills: Algorithm Design · Algorithm Analysis · Python (Programming Language)
